sailors.biography:
Miguel Morela Edra Barros Vasconcellos is a federated athlete by FEVERJ, is part of the State Youth Sailing team and the Grael’s Project team, regularly participates in national and international  competitions of the Sailing Sport. Morela was two-time Brazilian Dingue champion in 2021 and 2022, Copa Brasil of Optimist champion in 2023, Southeast Dingue champion 2024, played in the Trofeo Club Maritimo Melilla in Spain in 2023, Dingue South American Championship in Brazil in 2023, Optimist North American Championship in Puerto Rico in 2024, was called up to the Brasil Optimist South American Championship team in Paraguay in 2024 and will compete in the Optimist African Championship in Tanzania in 2025.

sailors.biography: Leon Zarchan is a Bahamian youth sailor who has competed in the Optimist class at both national and international level, representing The Bahamas in regional championships. He has now transitioned to the ILCA 4 class. He currently sails while studying at Eton College, where he trains and competes as part of the Eton College sailing team.
